{{Quote|If there were two suns, I'd swear I was back home on Tatooine!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="csw">"[[The Return of Ben Kenobi]]"</ref>}}
'''Aridus''' was a desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the reptilian [[Chubbit]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Geography==
[[File:IronTower-TheReturnOfBenKenobi.png|thumb|left|The [[Iron Tower]].]]
Aridus's surface was largely covered by sprawling deserts, though this terrain was dotted by volcanoes with lava pits and some small bodies of water like lakes and oases. The planet's few settlements, like [[Trade City (Aridus)|Aridus Trade City]], were located near any body of [[Water/Legends|water]] and mines. Aridus's sole [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species were the dimunitive reptilian [[Chubbit]]s which were oppressed under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which established [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on the planet. Other lifeforms included the reptilian [[droffi steed]]s and the [[Aridusian lava beetle]].

==History==
[[File:ChubbitResistance-TheReturnOfBenKenobi.png|thumb|right|250px|Chubbit resistance fighters during the Galactic Civil War]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Aridus stayed loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

Aridus was first scouted by Imperial scouts during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After valuable natural resources were found on the barren planet, various mining conglomerates including [[Yutrane-Trackata/Legends|Yutrane-Trackata]] set up operations on Aridus. However, Aridus's ionized atmopshere damaged the mining equipment. Unwilling to waste [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by scrapping all operations on Aridus, the sector [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] authorized the construction of a massive power transformer and signal amplifier&mdash;the [[Iron Tower]]. The operations resumed and [[hovertrain/Legends|Imperial Hover-train]]s transported workers to dig sites. In a bid to prove its loyalty, Yutrane-Trackata offered the Empire sole use of its mining vehicles and other heavy equipment.

Unfortunately, the Iron Tower's ultra-strong frequency waves crippled the nervous systems of the native Chubbits, thus killing many of the species. The Chubbits had already been disenfranchised by the Imperial colonization and were forced to wage a [[Chubbit resistance|guerrilla war]] on the Empire. However, several Yutrane-Trackata workers surreptitiously supplied Chubbit resistance fighters and members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] with [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|repulsor tanks]]<ref name="DB" /> and [[T4-B heavy tank|crawler tanks]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Iron Tower was [[Battle at the Iron Tower|destroyed]] by an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi impersonator|impersonator]] of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] as part of a ploy by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to lure [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] into a trap at the Iron Tower.<ref name="csw" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Aridus was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unused entries in the mastertextfile_english.dat<ref name="swtxt">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''&mdash;mastertextfile_english.dat</ref> of the [[2006]] [[LucasArts]] computer game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> refer to the "liberation of Aridus" from the Galactic Empire. The entries mention a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], an Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]], a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and a long range scanner as the participants, though a reference to a planned ground invasion is made. The briefing states that the Imperials are using the citizens of the system as [[Slavery/Legends|slave labor]] in the Imperial munitions factories.<ref name="swtxt" />
